name: XL Holdings Berhad
overview: XL Holdings 今年通过 XL Retail 收购了 34 家 GIANT Mini 迷你超市资产，并提议将业务多元化至杂货零售与批发；同时与关联方 North Cube 和 MAG Aquaculture 的鱼苗相关经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估逾 10%。
overview_en: XL Holdings acquired the assets of 34 GIANT Mini minimarts through XL Retail and proposed diversifying into grocery retailing and wholesaling; meanwhile, actual recurrent related party transactions with North Cube and MAG Aquaculture for hatchery-related dealings exceeded estimated values by more than 10%.

segments.name: 零售与批发杂货
segments.note: 今年通过收购 GIANT Mini 迷你超市资产进入杂货零售与批发业务，并提议将该业务纳入集团多元化范围。
segments.note_en: Entered grocery retailing and wholesaling this year through the acquisition of GIANT Mini minimart assets, with a proposed diversification to include this business.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DIVERSIFICATION OF THE EXISTING BUSINESS OF XL HOLDINGS BERHAD AND ITS SUBSIDIARIES TO
actions.text: 向股东发出通函，提议将现有业务多元化至包括杂货零售与批发业务。
actions.text_en: Issued a circular to shareholders proposing diversification of the existing business to include grocery retailing and wholesaling.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述收购于 2026 年 5 月 31 日完成，卖方保留 RM340,000 待履行完成后义务。
actions.text_en: The acquisition was completed on 31 May 2026, with RM340,000 retained pending the seller's completion of post-completion obligations.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: XL Retail 与 Jutaria Gemilang 签订资产购买协议，收购全马 34 家 GIANT Mini 迷你超市的租赁权、设备及存货等资产。
actions.text_en: XL Retail entered into an asset purchase agreement with Jutaria Gemilang to acquire the tenancies, equipment and inventories of 34 GIANT Mini minimarts across Malaysia.

segments.name: 鱼苗养殖
segments.note: 子公司 XL Hatchery 与关联方 North Cube 和 MAG Aquaculture 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估逾 10%。
segments.note_en: Actual recurrent related party transactions between subsidiary XL Hatchery and related parties North Cube and MAG Aquaculture exceeded estimated values by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: XL Hatchery 与 North Cube 的经常性关联交易实际值较预估进一步增加 10% 或以上。
actions.text_en: Actual value of recurrent related party transactions between XL Hatchery and North Cube further increased by 10% or more above the estimated value.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: XL Hatchery 与 MAG Aquaculture 的经常性关联交易实际值较预估进一步增加 10% 或以上。
actions.text_en: Actual value of recurrent related party transactions between XL Hatchery and MAG Aquaculture further increased by 10% or more above the estimated value.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: XL Hatchery 与 North Cube 及 MAG Aquaculture 的经常性关联交易实际总额超出通函预估逾 10%。
actions.text_en: Aggregate actual recurrent related party transactions between XL Hatchery and North Cube and MAG Aquaculture exceeded the circular's estimated value by more than 10%.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过 XL Retail 收购 34 家 GIANT Mini 迷你超市资产，新增杂货零售与批发业务线。
model_changes.text_en: Acquired the assets of 34 GIANT Mini minimarts through XL Retail, adding a grocery retailing and wholesaling business line.

model_changes.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DIVERSIFICATION OF THE EXISTING BUSINESS OF XL HOLDINGS BERHAD AND ITS SUBSIDIARIES TO
model_changes.text: 提议将集团现有业务多元化至包括杂货零售与批发业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversifying the group's existing business to include grocery retailing and wholesaling.
